items.title: Security forces kill 15 terrorists in Balochistan's Mastung district: state media
items.description:
Security forces have killed 15 terrorists during two separate operations in Balochistan’s Mastung district, state media reported on Saturday.
According to security sources cited by Radio Pakistan, five terrorists were killed in the first operation, while 10 others were eliminated in the second one. Both were conducted against Fitna al Hindustan under ‘Operation Raddul Fitna 3’, which began in August.
The state has designated outlawed Balochistan-based groups as Fitna al Hindustan to highlight India’s role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan.

items.title: CCD's school bag inspections in Punjab spark criticism on social media
items.description:
LAHORE: Punjab’s Crime Control Department (CCD) has started checking students’ school bags outside educational institutions for cigarettes, vapes and other intoxicating substances, drawing criticism from social media users over the involvement of law enforcement personnel in disciplining students.
After the CCD set up a checking point outside a college in Lahore on Friday, it issued a press release on Saturday announcing a special campaign across educational institutions in Punjab to protect children from drugs, cigarettes, vapes and other intoxicating substances.

items.title: Gujranwala, Multan overtake Lahore in air pollution
items.description:
LAHORE: Heavy smog pushed air quality in several Punjab cities into the hazardous category on Friday, with Lahore recording an hourly AQI reading of 465 between 7am and 8am, while Gujranwala and Multan registered readings of 661 and 641, respectively, according to real-time air quality data.
Lahore’s historical hourly air quality graph classified the reading of 465 as hazardous, indicating extremely polluted conditions and serious health risks for residents.
